caption.text:
Advokat Hotman Paris Hutapea mendatangi Gedung Jaksa Agung Muda Tindak Pidana Khusus (Jampidsus) Kejaksaan Agung pada Jumat pagi, 17 Juli 2026.

Berdasarkan informasi yang diperoleh Tempo, Hotman Paris akan ditunjuk sebagai kuasa hukum mantan Jaksa Agung Muda Tindak Pidana Khusus Febrie Adriansyah.

Baca selengkapnya di tempo.co dan link in bio.

#TUpdate #tempodotco #hotmanparis #jampidsus #febrieadriansyah
caption.text_translation:
Attorney Hotman Paris Hutapea arrives at the Special Crimes Young Prosecutor General (Jampidsus) House of the Supreme Prosecutor on Friday morning, July 17, 2026.

According to information obtained by Tempo, Hotman Paris will be appointed as the legal authority of former Special Crimes Young Attorney General Febrie Adriansyah.

Read more at tempo.co and link in bio.

 #TUpdate #tempodotco #hotmanparis #jampidsus #febrieadriansyah
